rawContent:
# Hello, I'm Somesh Chatterjee

Welcome to my interactive **Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS Desktop portfolio** simulation. 
  
I sit right at the intersection of **data science, software engineering, and system architecture**.

Currently, I serve as an **Advisor – Data Science** at Baker Hughes, where I focus on building intelligent, scalable systems that solve complex industrial challenges. Over the past decade and a half—spanning impactful tenures across GE and Baker Hughes—I’ve worn many hats: software architect, engineering lead, and lead data scientist.  

> **Explore Articles:** To browse all my publications and technical posts, open the **Application Grid** (the 9-dot launcher icon) in the bottom-left corner of the dock.  

---

## 🚀 What I Do

- **Industrial AI & Machine Learning**: Developing early detection and diagnostic systems for machine failure using statistical modeling, deep learning, and time-series anomaly detection.
- **Analytics & Platform Architecture**: Designing high-speed analytical platforms capable of real-time monitoring across single assets and entire industrial fleets.
- **Generative AI & LLMs**: Integrating large language models into operational workflows for sales simplification and software deployment.

---

## 🛠️ Technical Stack & Skills

### Core Competencies
`Machine Learning`, `Deep Learning`, `Systems Thinking`, `Generative AI`, `Time-Series Anomaly Detection`, `System Architecture`

### Languages & Frameworks
`Python`, `C++`, `LLMs`, `DiffusionModels`, `Explainable AI`

### Domain Focus
Asset Health Diagnostics, Energy Sector Analytics, Predictive Emission Monitoring

---

## 💡 Career & Research Highlights

1. **Enterprise AI & Diagnostics**: Led data science initiatives delivering automated anomaly detection and predictive failure models for rotating equipment in the energy domain.
2. **High-Speed Analytics Engine**: Architected an industrial-grade platform with C3.ai capable of running high-speed analytics across power plant fleets.
3. **Patents & Research**: Patented work in predictive emission monitoring alongside published research on DCT and codebook algorithms in pattern recognition.

---
